sentences.text: The genus Delphinornis includes three known species: D. arctowskii, D. gracilis, and D. larseni.
The genus Delphinornis was described by Wiman in 1905.
Delphinornis belongs to the order Sphenisciformes.
Delphinornis was an extinct genus of penguins that lived in Antarctica from the middle Eocene to the middle Miocene.
Fossils of Delphinornis date from 41.03 to 15.98 million years ago, spanning the Bartonian to Burdigalian stages.
